notif.title: Notifications
hint.guide: A quick walkthrough of the full KPI cycle. Click any step to jump to the right page.
guide.intro: From opening the measurement year to an approved scorecard — this is the whole cycle. Click a step to go there.
guide.s1d: The very first step: a KPI administrator opens the measurement year (Annual + Q1–Q4 periods) from Results & Submissions. A scheduled job also opens each new year automatically in January.
guide.s2d: Open Results & Submissions and click a KPI's period cell. A draft is created and any figures the system can compute from GL data are pre-filled.
guide.s3d: Confirm or adjust the suggested figures (AUTO / MANUAL badges show provenance), rate the assessment criteria, and attach the required evidence.
guide.s4d: Submission sends the measurement to the Section Head, then the Finance Director. Approvers act from My Worklist.
guide.s5d: Approved scores feed this dashboard and the annual KPI Briefing Book on the Reports page.
hint.overview: Headline figures for the selected year, based on approved measurements only.
hint.overall: Weighted average of each KPI's approved score (scorecard weights, default 25% each) on the DOF 1–5 scale.
dash.tileScoredSub: KPIs with an approved score this year
dash.tileApprovedSub: measurement periods approved — click to open
hint.inflight: Submitted measurements currently in the approval chain. Click to open My Worklist.
hint.cards: One card per KPI: average approved score, latest result, previous-year score and the period strip coloured by score. Click a card to open its measurements.
hint.chart: Average approved score per KPI for the selected year, against the maximum of 5.
res.genPeriodsHint: Creates the year's measurement calendar (Annual + Q1–Q4) — the first step of every KPI year.
hint.search: Pick the scorecard year. If the year has no measurement calendar yet, a KPI administrator generates it here — that is the very first step.
hint.matrix: Each cell is one measurement period. Click an empty cell to start a measurement, or an existing one to open it. A grey dash means the KPI is not measured at that frequency.
res.noPeriodsAdmin: No measurement calendar exists for {0} yet. Generate it to open the year — this is the very first step of the KPI cycle.
res.noPeriodsUser: No measurement calendar exists for {0} yet. Ask a KPI administrator to generate it (Results & Submissions → Generate periods) — that is the first step before any measurement can start.
res.legendStart: no measurement yet — click to start one
re.calcNoteBands: The score is the first matching band, checked from 5 down to 1; the result is rounded to 1 decimal before banding.
re.calcNoteWeighted: Each criterion contributes weight × (level ÷ 5) for maturity ratings, or weight × (achieved % ÷ 100) for achievement items.
re.calcNoteFlow: On submission the measurement goes to the Section Head, then the Finance Director; approved results lock and feed the scorecard.
hint.auto: AUTO = the figure was computed from platform data (GL). MANUAL = entered or adjusted by the preparer — overriding a system suggestion requires a justification note before submission.
hint.criteria: Rate each criterion against the circular's level descriptions (or enter the achievement %). Weights sum to 100%; the contribution of each criterion updates live.
hint.evidence: Attach the supporting documents required by the circular. When marked Required, the measurement cannot be submitted without at least one document.
hint.trail: Approval chain: Section Head, then Finance Director. A returned measurement can be corrected and resubmitted — a new approval cycle starts.
